horvath2013_coef.csv.source: Horvath S. DNA methylation age of human tissues and cell types. Genome Biol 2013;14:R115, Additional file 3 (13059_2013_3156_MOESM3_ESM.csv)
horvath2013_coef.csv.columns: CpGmarker, CoefficientTraining (row '(Intercept)' = 0.695507258), medianByCpG (author's gold-standard median, used to impute missing CpGs as in the author's R code)
horvath2013_coef.csv.licence: Open-access article (BioMed Central, Creative Commons Attribution licence). biolearn 0.9.1 usage metadata records no commercial restriction for Horvathv1 (it does for PhenoAge, Horvathv2, GrimAge, DNAmTL).

hannum2013_coef.csv.clock: Hannum 2013 blood DNAm age (71 CpGs, no intercept)
hannum2013_coef.csv.source: Hannum G et al. Genome-wide methylation profiles reveal quantitative views of human aging rates. Mol Cell 2013;49:359-367, Table S3; transcribed as biolearn 0.9.1 data/Hannum.csv (New BSD licence)
hannum2013_coef.csv.columns: CpGmarker, CoefficientTraining, median_sesame450k (missing-CpG imputation value from biolearn data/sesame_450k_median.csv; Hannum published no imputation reference)
hannum2013_coef.csv.licence: Coefficients are published numerical results; redistributed under biolearn's New BSD licence. No commercial-use restriction recorded by biolearn.

refused.DNAm PhenoAge (Levine 2018): Article is CC BY 3.0, but biolearn records commercial usage as requiring a licence (UCLA TDG / Clock Foundation). LongPi is commercial, so the clock is not computed from raw beta values; vendor values pass through only.
refused.GrimAge / GrimAge2 / DunedinPACE / Horva: Commercial licences (Clock Foundation / Duke / UCLA). Vendor values pass through only; never computed from raw data.
